method_fit.label: High-return compounder
applicability_tests: Owner earnings can be separated from stock compensation, working capital, and maintenance capital.
Incremental returns on retained capital are observable and durable.
The competitive advantage explains pricing, retention, share, or cost outcomes.
Terminal value is supported by a reinvestment runway rather than an unexplained multiple.
failure_modes: growth projected without its capital cost
terminal value unsupported by a durable mechanism

validation_cohort.purpose: Test depletion, commodity exposure, finite reserves, and royalty-unit reconciliation.
Test tangible capital, credit losses, funding, regulation, and excess-capital realization.
Test owner earnings, capital-light reinvestment, cyclicality, and buyback value creation.
Test normalized margins, industry supply response, replacement cost, and reinvestment timing.
Test product concentration, pipeline probabilities, patent cliffs, and catalyst timing.

method_fit.rule: Use one primary method and no more than two corroborating methods; irrelevant methods and personas remain silent.

outcomes.weighting_rule: Do not change a persona's relevance within a power zone until at least 20 attributable, dividend-aware outcomes exist there; never reweight automatically.

FY2025 10-K: revenue $42.7B (+5.2% YoY), operating income $2.2B, operating cash flow $3.6B, capital spending $1.2B.
Board and executive transitions continue; proxy discloses 93.5% shareholder support for 2025 named executive compensation.
Back-to-basics operating plan emphasizes shrink control, in-stock levels, and supply-chain reliability after prior execution missteps.
Debt reduction program and store-growth moderation as management prioritizes cash flow and inventory accuracy.
Occupational Safety and Health Administration citations and wage-hour litigation elevated compliance and labor cost focus in risk factors.
COVID-era consumables surge reinforced DG's rural and small-box convenience positioning versus big-box peers.
Accelerated new-store openings and cooler expansion broadened addressable trips beyond traditional dry consumables.

industry.structure: U.S. discount retail is concentrated among Dollar General, Dollar Tree/Family Dollar, Walmart neighborhood formats, and limited-assortment grocers; scale in purchasing and real-estate density matter more than brand premium.
industry.share_shift: Dollar General regained traffic after a 2023–2024 execution slump; Dollar Tree pursues multi-price formats; Walmart and regional grocers compete on fresh and delivery in overlapping geographies.
industry.trend: Shrink, labor availability, and supply-chain reliability dominate near-term margins; longer term, rural store density and consumables mix remain the core economic engine.
